samuel2.5.p1.b1.text: Here we are, your own flesh and blood.

samuel2.5.p1.b2.text: And to you the LORD said, ‘You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over them.’

samuel2.5.p1.b3.text: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, … And they anointed him king over Israel.

samuel2.5.p1.b4.text: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned forty years.

samuel2.5.p2.b1.text: Now the king and his men marched to Jerusalem against the Jebusites who inhabited the land.

samuel2.5.p2.b2.text: You will never get in here. Even the blind and lame can repel you.

samuel2.5.p2.b3.text: Whoever attacks the Jebusites must use the water shaft …

samuel2.5.p3.b1.text: Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion (that is, the City of David).

samuel2.5.p3.b2.text: And David became greater and greater, for the LORD God of Hosts was with him.

samuel2.5.p4.b1.text: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs, carpenters, and stonemasons, and they built a palace for David.

samuel2.5.p4.b2.text: And David realized that the LORD had established him as king over Israel and had exalted his kingdom for the sake of His people Israel.

samuel2.5.p5.b1.text: After he had arrived from Hebron, David took more concubines and wives from Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to him.

samuel2.5.p5.b2.text: These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

samuel2.5.p6.b1.text: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over Israel, they all went in search of him; … Now the Philistines had come and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim.

samuel2.5.p6.b2.text: Should I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?

samuel2.5.p6.b3.text: Go, … for I will surely deliver the Philistines into your hand.

samuel2.5.p6.b4.text: Like a bursting flood, the LORD has burst out against my enemies before me.

samuel2.5.p7.b1.text: Once again the Philistines came up and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim.

samuel2.5.p7.b2.text: Do not march straight up, but circle around behind them and attack them in front of the balsam trees.

samuel2.5.p7.b3.text: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, move quickly, …

samuel2.5.p7.b4.text: So David did as the LORD had commanded him, and he struck down the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.
